invariants.name: NO_LOCKED_VALUE_DEAD_END
invariants.statement: Every reachable state containing locked economic value must have at least one valid path to an economically terminal state.

invariants.name: AT_MOST_ONCE_ECONOMIC_EFFECT
invariants.statement: A finalized business action may produce its economic effect at most once.

invariants.name: TIMEOUT_REQUIRES_RECOVERY_PATH
invariants.statement: Every expired time-bounded state that still contains economic value must retain a valid recovery path.

invariants.name: SINGLE_VALID_SUCCESSOR_PER_STATE_VERSION
invariants.statement: Mutually exclusive transitions must not both commit from the same state version, and every transition must commit against the state version on which it was authorized.
